prompt.task: Propose ONE executable TimingSkill to improve inspection timing using only supplied causal public experience. A distinct skill is useful only if its actual CHECK/CONTINUE_TOUR behavior changes.
prompt.common_contract: Known static layout,18 qualified owned executors,1800s; at most ONE additional check for the whole team. CONTINUE_TOUR continues mandatory work and preserves quota. External original legality,60s cooldown,fullreturn and exactrevisit are immutable. Do not invent observations or read future faults.

skill_schema.rules: 0..3 OR rules; each exactly {all:[1..6 AND predicates]}; CHECK iff any complete rule true; otherwise CONTINUE_TOUR

professional_signal.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

inspection_age_ratio.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

direct_age_s.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

direct_age_ratio.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

estimate_age_s.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

thermal_disagreement.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

prior_disagreement.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

pod_thermal_signal.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

pod_flow_deficit.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

pod_service_gap.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

lead_s.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

shift_s.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

completion_cost_s.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

importance.missing: is_missing requires null; numeric comparison with missing is false

skill_schema.kind_threshold: .5 for control, .05 otherwise; profession must be known

public_feature_meanings.professional_signal: Existing own-profession cue: thermal fused excess/qualified contact/observed flow/qualified verified bias; None when unavailable, not a probability.
public_feature_meanings.direct_reading_normal: Available direct channel is on its reference-normal side. Not hidden truth or a guarantee of normality; remote versus qualified explicitly separated.
public_feature_meanings.direct_is_qualified: Most recent direct reading is a qualified reference, not merely a remote/model value.
public_feature_meanings.direct_age_s: Age of actual direct reading; None means missing. Thermal may be remote or qualified; other roles retain their declared sources.
public_feature_meanings.estimate_age_s: Timestamped pure temperature-CVAE invocation age; None when timestamp unavailable. Legacy30s reconstruction only when explicitly requested for verified E1 tapes.
public_feature_meanings.thermal_disagreement: Thermal tool difference/20: target rack for thermal, maximum of existing observed/estimated thermal racks in the same public pod otherwise. Not cross-profession uncertainty probability.
public_feature_meanings.prior_disagreement: Pure existing temperature-CVAE prior mean versus causal nominal model/20; missing on old tapes without raw prior recorder. Not a fault probability.
public_feature_meanings.pod_thermal_signal: Maximum available fused temperature excess in public same-pod thermal tasks; a cross-system cue, not confirmation.
public_feature_meanings.pod_flow_deficit: Existing observed same-pod flow deficit; None when not observed.
public_feature_meanings.pod_service_gap: Existing per-rack public requested/delivered IT power aggregated over known8-rack pod. Service-gap proxy, not voltage/current or contact-hotspot confirmation.
public_feature_meanings.inspection_age_ratio: Public qualified-check age/deadline, including startup age; distinct from direct remote measurement age.
public_feature_meanings.lead_s: Earlier completion than continuing protected Tour, from public deterministic route/service model.
public_feature_meanings.shift_s: Additional public own-tour schedule shift from optional check, not empirical risk or a safety rule.
public_feature_meanings.already_alarm: Already measured public alarm, not hidden truth. Rechecking it is not a new physical-event discovery.
public_feature_meanings.professional_available: An actual own-profession cue exists; false makes professional_signal null.
public_feature_meanings.ever_checked: At least one qualified check completed.
public_feature_meanings.quota_available: True for candidates before the single additional opportunity is consumed.
public_feature_meanings.estimate_available: Temperature-CVAE tool output exists; timestamp can still be unknown.
public_feature_meanings.importance: Public normalized consequence importance, not a fault probability.
public_feature_meanings.direct_available: Actual direct channel exists, including remote readings where explicitly allowed.

data.instruction: Use typed measured evidence to propose one distinct program that may confirm anomalies earlier without unnecessary detours. Return to the protected tour when extra checking lacks evidence.

format_example.diagnosis: The initial reference is supplied in data.
format_example.expected_effect: This is the initial reference only, not an improved answer.
